text:
Priority: urgent
Share one build cache across jobs so several jobs can build at once without each paying for a full build and its disk. Today each job builds into its own target directory (about 10 to 16 GB each, and a full build each time), which caps drain at one job and made a two-job run fail on disk on 2026-10-26. Use a shared cargo target or compiler cache (for example sccache or a shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR with per-job locking where needed) for the producer, Athena's checks and the verifier, and measure the change in check time and disk per job.
Acceptance:
- A measurement on this repository, recorded in docs/decisions.md, of build-plus-test time and disk per job before and after, labelled as a measurement.
- Two jobs can build at the same time without corrupting each other's results: a test or a recorded two-job run shows both pass their checks.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs, setup.sh, docs/decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md
